validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot now uses `continue` instead of `return` when the destination session file already exists, so one collision skips only that file, preserves both copies, and the remaining batch still migrates. The standalone regression loads the real module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with the real fs/path modules and a workspace-local temporary agentDir. It asserts: a later file is transferred after a collision; the colliding source and pre-existing destination are both preserved byte-for-byte; malformed JSON and non-session headers remain untouched; only the expected session directories are created; and a second run is idempotent while still transferring a newly added later file. The script exited 0 on the fixed checkout and, when replayed against an isolated copy restored to the original `return` fault, exited 1 with `AssertionError: later session should be transferred after a collision`. No dependencies or network were used; only Node 24 built-ins. Temp check directories were removed after validation.
